profile.headline: Supervisory IT Project Manager | Leading Enterprise IT Projects | Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As Supervisory IT Project Manager at the U.S. Department of State, I lead the Service Delivery Branch, managing a portfolio of enterprise IT projects that align technology initiatives with the Bureau of Administration’s mission. With over three years in this capacity, I have overseen critical service delivery functions, optimized team performance, and ensured operational excellence while driving continuous improvement. My AWS Solutions Architect certification supports my focus on leveraging cloud technologies to enhance service efficiency and scalability.  

Previously, as an Information Technology Specialist at the Department of State, I contributed to the modernization of enterprise systems and migration to the cloud by collaborating with cross-functional teams. My expertise in project leadership, the software development life cycle, and cloud migration enables me to deliver impactful, user-centric solutions that meet organizational goals. Passionate about empowering teams to deliver secure, scalable applications, I remain committed to ensuring exceptional service delivery and operational success.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the requirements gathering and analysis process to ensure software solutions aligned with client needs. Designed, developed, and deployed full-stack applications with a focus on robust functionality and user experience. Performed thorough testing—including unit, integration, and user acceptance—to uphold high-quality standards. Delivered post-launch support and maintenance to optimize system performance and improve user satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET Core · jQuery · Asp.net MVC Development · Microsoft SQL Server · Team Leadership · Agile Methodologies · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Software Engineering Practices

positions.title: Supervisory IT Project Manager (Branch Chief)
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description: Results-driven IT leader serving as Branch Chief for the Service Delivery Branch, directing a portfolio of enterprise IT projects, aligning technology initiatives with organizational strategy, and ensuring exceptional service delivery across the Bureau of Administration. Provided oversight of staff, budgets, and policies to support mission-critical operations and continuous improvement.

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist, Project Manager
positions.description: Senior developer and technical lead specializing in Microsoft technologies, responsible for architecting, developing, and delivering enterprise web applications and dashboards. Partnered with cross-functional teams to modernize systems, migrate to the cloud, and implement analytics solutions aligned with organizational goals.

positions.title: Web Master Technician III
positions.description:
Lead developer specializing in web and database solutions, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining mission-critical applications, websites, and dashboards for the Bureau of Administration. Delivered innovative systems, improved user interfaces, and supported emergency communication and
operations through technology.
positions.insights: Skills: Enterprise Application Development · Asp.net MVC Development · Development Lead · Cloud Modernization · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description: Supported critical IT initiatives for the National Security Division by developing and modernizing secure applications, automating workflows, and improving system performance on sensitive networks.
positions.insights: Skills: Process Automation · Application Modernization · ASP.NET MVC · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET)

positions.title: Senior Web Master
positions.description: Led the design and development of mission-critical applications to enhance emergency communication and internal operations. Delivered backend automation, API integration, and mobile-accessible solutions for secure government environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Enterprise Application Development · Web Application Development · User Interface Design · Mobile Applications · Asp.net MVC Development

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped with feeding the homeless at S.O.M.E (So Others May Eat) in the Washington, DC area; Volunteered as a coach at the LAWCF Sound Mind Sound Body Academy in Detroit, MI and Washington, DC. Volunteered as mentor for the V-Davis MVP Academy Saturday Program.

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentoring and coaching youth between the ages of 5-10.
